XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Difficult starting, noisy engine with low idle speed and engine failure light on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0016 | SOLENOID VALVE | VARIATOR | PHASE | ELECTRICAL | VALVE | SWITCHES ON | ON | MIL | YELLOW | INDICATION | MESSAGE | DISPLAY | NOISE | ABNORMAL | IDLE | RPM |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Phase-shifting solenoid valve

  • Fault: The engine fault warning light comes on with the message “Have engine checked” on the display, and there is an abnormal noise from the engine at idle (a whistling sound). However, the vehicle continues to run smoothly.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0016 (Crankshaft 1 position/phase, bank 1 – Incorrect ratio)

  • Cause: The oil-immersed part of the variable valve timing solenoid valve was found to be contaminated, with an internal spring jammed.

• Action: Check the condition of the phase variator solenoid valve; clean it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The solenoid valve has a part immersed in oil, where a spring was found to be jammed and a filter was found to be clogged. Following the cleaning of the variable valve timing solenoid valve, the fault was permanently resolved without the need for replacement.
    The component is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side, near the oil filler cap, between the engine and the passenger compartment.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 0.7 hours.
